Visit note | 2025-10-05 04:30 PM | Dr. Kamrul Hasan, Pulmonology | Patient: Ziaur Shikder, 67, male. Mr. Shikder returns for review reporting more sputum than usual alongside his long history of smoking. He is a retired civil servant whose symptoms flared after rubbish was burned near his home in Sirajganj. He takes his inhalers regularly and denies chest pain, fever, or ankle swelling.
